package.name: tenso_ros
package.description: ROS2 integration for the Tenso tensor wire format: an rclcpp::TypeAdapter mapping a TensorView application type to the tenso_msgs/TensoBlob message for zero-copy intra-process tensor transport, plus publisher/subscriber skeletons and a "hello tensor" A/B demo vs sensor_msgs/Image. Linux-only (ROS2 Humble or newer).
